items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I found a job playing my horn immediately; that's when I was with Carl Johnson.

ctx.x: Did you work any during that time in San Francisco?
No. I think I had about a half a dozen gigs. Finally I figured that wasn't the place for me and I ended up back in Los Angeles, in October, 1942.
I found a job playing my horn immediately; that's when I was with Carl Johnson.

items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Incidentally, I know the address there was 1710 South Central Avenue.

ctx.x: musicians union as it was called. Incidentally, I know the address there was 1710 South Central Avenue.
